name: questlife
description: QuestLife - application de gestion d objectifs gamifiee
author: QuestLife

scripts.electron:build: npm run build && npm run electron:make-icon && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json --win nsis
scripts.electron:build:dir: npm run build && npm run electron:make-icon && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json --win dir
scripts.electron:build:signed: node -e "if(!process.env.CSC_LINK||!process.env.CSC_KEY_PASSWORD){console.error('Missing CSC_LINK or CSC_KEY_PASSWORD');process.exit(1)}" && npm run electron:build
